known_mismatch.reason: `~` with a constant array operand: PHP converts constant operands of ZEND_CONCAT at compile time and emits a ZEND_CAST to string for a constant array after compiling both operands (zend_compile_binary_op(), PHPSRC/Zend/zend_compile.c), so "Array to string conversion" is raised before the concat fails on the object operand; twig-rs evaluates the concat in one step and throws without the warning (suspected: src/lltl/codegen.rs, codegen of ConcatBinary: a constant array operand needs its own cast step after both operands are evaluated).

known_mismatch.reason: line of an error inside an array or hash literal (also the values of a multi-target `set`, compiled as `[...] = [...]`): PHP's zend_try_ct_eval_array() runs zend_eval_const_expr() over every element (it descends into binary/unary ops, ??, ?:, dims and nested arrays, not into calls) and replaces foldable constants (the `null` of every non-strict `($context["x"] ?? null)`, true/false, -1, constant arrays) by new zval ASTs that carry the array literal's start line; the opcode compiled right after such a constant (here the CONCAT) gets that line, so Error::guess() reports the line where the array starts. twig-rs attributes the instruction to the last debug marker (suspected: src/lltl/codegen.rs, line table of instructions emitted inside ArrayExpression elements).
